title: Calendar and routines
summary: Read and manage all temporal commitments, deadlines, reusable routines, generated events, and their links to to-dos.

batch.reason: One event creation owns one temporal and recurrence validation boundary and one event-scoped receipt.
A stored event or recurring series update has one scope and optimistic event identity.
Archival is an event-scoped lifecycle transition handled by the same versioned update.

delete.note: Delete is logical archival through event status, not permanent erasure.

batch.reason: One routine defines one recurrence and generated-event ownership boundary.
Routine changes use one optimistic version and never rewrite sibling generated events.
Disabling one versioned routine preserves already generated event history.

delete.note: Delete is the reversible disabled lifecycle state.

resources.title: Calendar event contact
resources.summary: A role-qualified connection between one concrete calendar event and one contact.

update.note: Replace the exact role-qualified edge without replacing sibling contacts.

resources.title: Calendar event to-do
resources.summary: A work, deadline, or context connection between one concrete calendar event and one personal to-do.

update.note: Set the exact edge kind without reconstructing sibling links.

resources.title: Calendar event correspondence provenance
resources.summary: A source-owned correspondence link retained with a calendar event.
resources.reason: Correspondence ingestion owns this provenance edge; calendar CRUD must not rewrite imported provider evidence.
